title: Native of Savoy Dies at Age 88
text:
Native of Savoy
Dies at Age 88

MRS. A. DEATHERAGE.

SAVOY, Texas.—Mrs. Sarah Malissa Deatherage, 88, died at 2 a. m. Friday at her home here following an illness of two months. Funeral services will be held at 2 p. m. Saturday at the residence, with J. B. May, a friend of the family, conducting. Interment will be in Sunnyside cemetery. Talley of Sherman directing.

Born Aug. 8, 1856, in the Nahurin community south of Savoy, she was the daughter of Mr. and Mrs. James Ray. She was married to A. Deatherage Aug. 26, 1875. Mr. Deatherage died two years ago at the age of 94. A member of the Church of Christ, Mrs. Deatherage lived in this community all her life and at the present home 50 years.

Survivors include one son, Frank Deatherage of Hugo, Okla.; six daughters, Mrs. B. E. Mathews of Fort Worth, Mrs. W. P. Carter of Dallas, Mrs. J. W. Jenkins of Bells, Mrs. Paul Houston of Lubbock, Mrs. C. D. Hastings of Longview, and Mrs. Ann Tyler, also of Hugo; grandchildren and nine great-grandchildren.
